newsitem.title: USA: Source One to sell servicing rights.
newsitem.headline: Source One to sell servicing rights.

text.p: Source One Mortgage Services Corp said Monday it accepted a bid to sell $19 billion of mortgage servicing rights.
The company expects the transaction to close early in 1997. Following the sale, Source One would retain subservicing on the portfolio for up to three years.
It said the ultimate value of the transaction will be determined when a definitive purchase and sale agreement is executed.

After the transaction, Source One would continue to own a servicing portfolio of about $10 billion to $12 billion, while the new subservicing agreement together with existing subservicing contracts would make the company the largest mortgage subservicer in the nation.
Over the past six months, Source One said it has conducted an extensive strategic review. Some of the options in addition to this proposed sale of servicing rights are still being explored.
